 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Entrepreneurship"** means the activity of setting up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit. (उद्यमिता)

 
 
• **Example: **Many universities now offer courses in **entrepreneurship **to encourage students to start their own businesses.
 
 
 
• **"Colleague" **refers to a person with whom one works, especially in a profession or business. (सहकर्मी)
 
 
• **Example: **She discussed the project with her** colleague** during the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consencus** (सम्मति): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "Consensus," which means a general agreement.

 
 
• **Example:** The group reached a consensus on the new policy after several hours of discussion.
 
 
 
• **Colleague** (सहकर्मी): A person with whom one works in a profession or business.
 
 
• **Example: **She often has lunch with her colleagues from the marketing department.
 
 
 
• **Bizzaire** (अजीब): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "Bizarre," which means very strange or unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** He had a bizarre dream where he was flying over the city.
